state.goal: Report the latest merchant list price on price.com.hk for Sony PlayStation 5 as of yesterday (2026-10-01 Asia/Hong_Kong): among quotes whose update_date equals yesterday, select the lowest listed HKD price (最平報價 for that day).

exclude: Quotes updated today or earlier than yesterday
Wrong product variants already rejected at navigation
Do not invent prices absent from state.quotes

state.permissions: Read-only; no purchase or merchant contact.

quote_is_as_of_yesterday_eligible.instructions: Is there at least one quote in state.quotes whose update_date equals state.as_of_policy.yesterday and that has a numeric price_hkd?

criteria.true: One or more quotes are dated yesterday with a listed HKD price.
criteria.false: No yesterday-dated quote with a listed price is present.

lowest_price_quote_as_of_yesterday.instructions: Using only state.quotes and state.as_of_policy, choose the candidate id of the eligible yesterday quote with the lowest price_hkd. If several share that price, prefer 行貨 over 水貨/unknown, then the earlier candidate id. Choose none if no quote qualifies.

criteria.q1: 軟硬電腦 Softhard Computer: HK$5399.0 行貨 updated 2026-10-02
criteria.q2: Pro Toy Shop: HK$5200.0 行貨 updated 2026-10-01
criteria.q3: Foresoon Computer 科訊電腦: HK$5580.0 行貨 updated 2026-10-01
criteria.q4: Hill Sound: HK$3400.0 行貨 updated 2024-10-29
criteria.none: No quote is eligible for the as-of-yesterday rule.

evidence_enough_to_report_price.instructions: Is the supplied product identity plus yesterday-dated quote list sufficient to report a single HKD list price for Sony PlayStation 5 as of yesterday without browsing further?

criteria.true: Product is identified and at least one eligible yesterday quote exists.
criteria.false: Product mismatch, missing dates, or no usable yesterday quote.
